concepts: ClinicalTrials.gov phase III fecal microbiota transplantation immune checkpoint inhibitor solid tumor
WHO ICTRP microbiome intervention phase 3 cancer immunotherapy
gap.question: Are there any ongoing or completed but unpublished Phase III randomized controlled trials of microbiome interventions (FMT, probiotics, defined consortia) combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumour patients registered in ClinicalTrials.gov or WHO ICTRP?
success_criteria: Confirmation of absence or identification of specific trial registry numbers (NCT identifiers) with Phase III status, solid tumour indications, microbiome intervention arms, and ICI combinations. If absent, document the search strategy, date, and filters used.
gap.user_scope: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?
